item.title: Aisha Buhari opens up on rumoured plan to kill late president
item.description: Aisha Buhari, the wife of the late former President Muhammadu Buhari, has unraveled the mystery behind the claim the Aso Rock rumour of plot to kill her husband.

item.title: Breaking: Tears as NLC loses prominent warlord to death
item.description: The NLC has expressed grief and lamentation as an influential leader of the union passes away. Details surrounding his death was announced in a statement.

item.title: Asian markets retreat ahead of US jobs as tech worries weigh
item.description: Asian markets extended losses with Wall Street on Tuesday as investors jockeyed for position ahead of key US jobs and inflation data, while sentiment remains subdued by worries over a possible tech bubble. Worries over the tech sector were also weighing on sentiment, with recent warnings about an AI-fuelled bubble compounded by weak disappointing earnings last week from Oracle and Broadcom.

item.title: Bello Turji opens up on 2 former governors allegedly fuelling Nigeria’s insecurity; video goes viral
item.description: Bello Turji has claimed that two former governors are allegedly fueling insecurity in Nigeria, igniting reactions as the video went viral online.

item.title: Aisha Buhari breaks silence on alleged poisoning of ex-president
item.description: Aisha Buhari, ex-first lady, has broken the silence on the claim that late President Muhammadu Buhari was poisoned in 2017, leading to his 154 days of medical leave.

item.title: 'Waiting to die': the dirty business of recycling in Vietnam
item.description: Crouched between mountains of discarded plastic, Lanh strips the labels off bottles of Coke, Evian and local Vietnamese tea drinks so they can be melted into tiny pellets for reuse. In Minh Khai, the owner of a plant producing plastic pellets said domestic supply "is not enough".

item.title: EU set to scrap 2035 combustion-engine ban in car industry boost
item.description: The EU looks set to scrap a landmark 2035 ban on new petrol and diesel cars on Tuesday, as part of a package of reforms aimed at supporting Europe's embattled auto industry. Set in 2023, the ban was a cornerstone of the EU's environmental Green Deal, which has come under increased pressure from businesses and right-wing politicians as the EU seeks to bolster its industry.

item.title: Bank of Japan expected to hike rates to 30-year high
item.description: The Bank of Japan is expected to hike interest rates Friday for the first time since January, pushing them to their highest level in 30 years and potentially exacerbating turmoil in debt markets. Yields on 30-year bond yields reached a record high in early December, and 10-year yields last week hittheir highest level in 19 years.

item.title: Canada plow-maker can't clear path through Trump tariffs
item.description: For decades, Arctic Snowplows has sold its Canadian-made galvanized steel products to "anywhere there is snow" across the border in the United States, says company president Mike Schulz. But Canadian sales are only a "fraction" of what the company has historically made in the United States, he said.

item.title: Regina Daniels accuses Ned Nwoko of seeking full custody of her kids, shares details
item.description: Regina Daniels expresses heartbreak over her ex-husband's public exposure of their children and shares her pain over their ongoing custody battle.
